# 🚨
M-W things they are variants but Ox thinks they are separate words
and I agree:
  _: archetypal / _v: archetypical
  _: symmetrical / _v: symmetric
  _: teenage / _v: teenaged

This one is a little less certain, Ox Can things thare are variants, but I 
killed it anyway.
  _: alphabetical / _v: alphabetic


# sweepstakes <verified> (level 35)
A Bv C: sweepstakes / AV B Cv: sweepstake / AV: sweep-stake
